title: Motions of the Earth
quote: Coriolis is zero at the Equator and maximum at the poles: the opposite of rotation speed

boxes.title: Rotation facts
items: Angular speed **15° per hour** = 1° every **4 minutes**
Counter-clockwise seen from North Pole; only **Venus, Uranus** reverse
Solar day ~**4 min** longer than sidereal day
Not felt: uniform motion; atmosphere rotates along
Ice melt slows rotation: days longer ~**1.33 ms per century** (UPSC 2025: axis shift)

cards.title: Ferrel's law
lines: Right in NH, left in SH

boxes.title: Day & night
items: Caused by ==**rotation**== (not revolution or tilt alone)
**Circle of illumination** = terminator = "**grey line**" (APPSC 2019); through both poles only at equinoxes
Equator: ~**12 h** day all year; poles ~**6 months** day + 6 night
**Midnight Sun**: beyond Arctic/Antarctic Circle near summer solstice; **Norway**
Twilight **shortest at Equator**, longest at high latitudes

boxes.title: Coriolis effect
items: Apparent deflection from rotation (APPSC-G1 2019; BPSC 2022)
==**Zero at Equator, maximum at poles**==; rises with latitude & velocity (UPSC 2024)
∝ **2Ωv sin(latitude)**; acts on winds, currents, cyclones
Cyclones rarely within **5°** of Equator; spin **anticlockwise in NH**

boxes.title: Revolution & leap year
items: **365 days 6 hours**; extra quarter day → 1 day in 4 years
Leap year **366** days: **29 February**
Century year leap only if ÷ ==**400**== (2000 yes, 1900 no)
Sun's gravity = centripetal force

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Day & night = **rotation**; seasons = **revolution + axial tilt**
Grey line / twilight zone = circle of illumination (APPSC 2019)
Rotation period **24 h** (⚠ other notes: **23 h 56 m 4 s**)
Cyclone **Montha** (2025) hit **Kakinada** coast: Coriolis + steering winds
